description: Na₄Ga₃(SiO₄)₃BH₄ crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. The structure consists of two BH₄ clusters inside a Na₄Ga₃(SiO₄)₃ framework. In each BH₄ cluster, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All B-H bond lengths are 1.23 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one B atom. In the Na₄Ga₃(SiO₄)₃ framework, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. Ga is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Ga-O bond lengths are 1.85 Å. Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.65 Å. O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom.
